source_repair_historical_source_metadata.pell_core_source_discrepancy: The natural modern binomial identification produces n^6 instead of the printed n^2. U_em remains unresolved.

source_repair_historical_source_metadata.source_reconciliation: The 1980 display uses Greek alpha in the d row; the emendation uses Latin a, supported by the 1999 survey, whose separate Pell-row typo is also corrected. See the source reconciliation section of undecidability/papers/jones1980_quartic_transfer.tex.
